name: THE PATRONS
note: One of the Nugget’s nine. Doc 05 gives THE PATRONS its words as a single hotspot, so these carry no tree of their own -- the dog’s precedent: a figure that is drawn and breathes, with the words on the hotspot. Facing the bar, back to the room.

sprite.note: Two-frame breath. Rates and phases are all different so no two groups in the room move together.
